text: Astronomy is the study of the universe, including the stars, planets, galaxies, and other celestial bodies. One fascinating aspect of astronomy is nebulae, which are clouds of gas and dust that emit light and heat. These clouds are often visible to the naked eye as colorful patches in the night sky. To better observe and study these cosmic phenomena, astronomers use powerful telescopes, such as the Hubble Space Telescope, which have allowed us to learn more about the composition and structure of these elusive objects.
